panel.mockNote: Sample data — mockup (Phase 1). Not yet wired to the real server.

power.heading: Service actions
power.intro: Power and common operations. Each action is enabled based on the server's current state.
power.taskFailed: The task ended with an error. Check the task history.
power.passwordEmailed: New password emailed to you (one-time link).
power.confirmBody: This is a power cut: unsaved data may be lost. To confirm, type the server name.
power.errorBusy: There's a task in progress. Wait for it to finish.
power.errorTooMany: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.

tasks.heading: Task history
tasks.error: Couldn't read the history right now.

graficas.heading: Graphs
graficas.introRrd: CPU, memory and network usage from the hypervisor. Install the agent to also see disk and swap inside the system.

snapshots.heading: Snapshots
snapshots.intro: Save the disk state so you can roll back to it. Snapshots are not a replacement for backups.
snapshots.revertBody: The disk will return to the state of "{snapshot}". Everything after it is lost. To confirm, type the server name.

consola.heading: noVNC console
consola.intro: Access the server's screen as if you were in front of it. Handy when you can't get in over SSH/RDP.

backups.heading: Backups
backups.intro: Full machine backups (vzdump) stored on the node. Taken live, without shutting the server down.
backups.noStorage: This node doesn't have a backup storage configured yet.
backups.creating: Creating the backup… this may take a few minutes.
backups.failed: The backup ended with an error. Check the task history.

notif.heading: Resource notifications
notif.intro: We email you if CPU stays above {cpu}%, memory above {mem}% or disk above {disco}% for a sustained period, or if the agent stops responding.
notif.noAgent: Install the metrics agent to monitor resources and get alerts.

reinstalar.heading: Reinstall
reinstalar.intro: Reinstall the operating system from scratch. This wipes the ENTIRE disk: back up first if you need to keep data.
reinstalar.confirmBody: The whole disk will be erased. To confirm, type the server name:
reinstalar.started: Reinstall queued. Follow the progress in the task history.
reinstalar.invalidOs: That system isn't available or doesn't fit on the disk.

firewall.heading: Firewall
firewall.intro: Filter your server's traffic. Requires the datacenter firewall to be enabled.
firewall.lockoutWarning: With the inbound policy set to DROP and no rule allowing your access (SSH/RDP), you'll lock yourself out. Add a rule allowing your connection first.

management.heading: Service management
management.intro: Advanced tools to administer your server.

info.heading: Information
info.passwordManaged: Not stored. Use "Change password": a one-time link is emailed to you.

error.title: Couldn't load the service
error.body: We couldn't reach the provisioning server. The service is still active; please try again in a few seconds.
